name: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) & Multi-Agent Facets
description: Standardized Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interoperability and multi-agent orchestration framework governing AI-to-AI and AI-to-Human coordination facets, Agent Cards and semantic capability discovery, structured task delegation lifecycles (submitted, working, input_required, completed, failed, escalated), multi-agent topologies (supervisor-router, specialist swarm, critic-verifier guard, human advocate escalation), scoped shared memory and cryptographic provenance chains, confidence-band gating, and semantic safety handshakes.
roleInCenter: Multi-agent coordination protocol: enables frontline conversational agents, domain-specialist AI agents, policy verifier agents, and human advocates to discover capabilities, delegate sub-tasks safely, verify outputs, and escalate with auditable provenance.

glossary.definition: Machine-readable JSON metadata manifest published by an autonomous agent declaring its unique identifier, natural-language skill descriptions, supported input and output schemas, authentication requirements, tool authority scopes, latency SLAs, and cost tiers

Deterministic state machine governing an inter-agent delegated task across canonical states (submitted, working, input_required, completed, failed, canceled, and escalated) with idempotent state transition events and streaming artifact emission

Runtime matchmaking handshake in which a client or supervisor agent queries the A2A registry for candidate specialist agents, evaluates their Agent Cards against task constraints, and negotiates schema, budget, and assurance terms before delegation

Coordinating control-plane agent that decomposes complex, multi-intent customer requests into atomic sub-tasks, routes each sub-task to qualified domain specialist agents, monitors progress, and synthesizes unified responses

Purpose-built autonomous agent scoped to a narrow vertical domain (such as billing dispute adjudication, technical diagnostics, or travel rebooking) with dedicated RAG corpora, fine-tuned reasoning, and least-privilege API tool access

Independent guardrail agent that inspects proposed specialist agent actions, tool payloads, and customer-facing drafts prior to execution to verify factual grounding, regulatory compliance, financial ceiling adherence, and absence of prompt injection

Structured inter-agent message payload encapsulating the delegated goal, scoped subset of the Omnichannel Context Envelope, parent task lineage, security delegation token, recursion depth counter, and deadline budget

Immutable, append-only audit trail recording every agent invocation, Agent Card version, retrieved knowledge citation, tool call input and output, critic verdict, and confidence score across a multi-agent interaction

Decision policy aligned with engine confidence bands that allows autonomous execution in the high band, requires critic verification or customer confirmation in the medium band, and triggers warm escalation to a human advocate in the low band

Short-lived, permission-scoped collaborative memory workspace where cooperating agents read and write intermediate findings, resolved slots, and sub-task artifacts without exposing raw cross-domain PII or unverified chain-of-thought noise

Zero-trust authorization envelope restricting a specialist agent to only the specific CRM mutations, refund limits, and external API scopes explicitly delegated by the customer session and parent orchestrator

Structured AI-to-Human elevation protocol that packages the Multi-Agent Provenance Ledger, unresolved sub-task state, critic rejection reason, and recommended next action into an interactive co-pilot briefing for a live agent or supervisor

children.name: Agent Card Metadata & Skill Declarations
children.description: Standardized self-description published by every participating agent in the CXOS fabric

children.name: Input & Output JSON Schema & Modality Contract
children.description: Strict input slot requirements, output artifact schemas, and supported streaming modalities (text, structured cards, audio)

children.name: Agent Version, Model & Prompt Lineage

children.name: Authority, Security & RBAC Scopes

children.name: On-Behalf-Of (OBO) Customer Scoped Token
children.description: Binds agent tool execution strictly to the authenticated customer party ID and verified assurance level

children.name: Autonomous Financial & Policy Ceiling
children.description: Hard dollar and policy thresholds (such as maximum autonomous credit or fee waiver) above which human or critic approval is mandatory

children.name: Operational SLA, Latency & Token Budgets
children.description: Runtime resource envelopes negotiated prior to sub-task delegation

children.name: Sub-Task Turn Latency Budget
children.description: Maximum millisecond deadline allocated to a specialist agent before the orchestrator triggers a fallback or async continuation

children.name: Maximum Delegation Hop & Token Ceiling
children.description: Hard cap on agent-to-agent delegation depth and cumulative token spend per contact turn

facets.name: Multi-Agent Coordination Topologies
facets.description: Structural execution patterns for coordinating frontline, specialist, verifier, and human agents

children.name: Hub-and-Spoke Supervisor Orchestration
children.description: Central frontline orchestrator retains customer conversation ownership while dispatching bounded tasks to domain specialists

children.name: Multi-Intent Decomposition Planner
children.description: Splits compound customer utterances (such as 'dispute my bill and update my shipping address') into dependency-ordered sub-tasks

children.name: Unified Brand Persona Response Weaver
children.description: Synthesizes outputs from multiple specialist agents into a single coherent voice or chat turn so the customer experiences one unified assistant

children.name: Sequential Pipeline & Parallel Fan-Out Topologies
children.description: Chained and concurrent execution graphs across multiple specialist agents

children.name: Parallel Specialist Fan-Out & Scatter-Gather
children.description: Concurrently queries outage telemetry, billing ledger, and device diagnostics agents to assemble a holistic root-cause view in sub-second time

children.name: Sequential Stage Relay Pipeline
children.description: Ordered handoff chain where triage agent passes structured findings to adjudication agent and then to fulfillment agent

children.name: Critic-Verifier Gate & Human Advocate Topologies
children.description: Safety verification rings and warm human-in-the-loop transitions

children.name: Pre-Commit Critic & Policy Gate
children.description: Synchronous constitutional verifier step that audits high-impact specialist proposals before any external API mutation or customer promise is committed

children.name: AI-to-Human Warm Advocate Escalation
children.description: Transitions control to a skilled live agent via ACD while keeping specialist agents attached in co-pilot shadow mode to assist the human

facets.name: Task Lifecycle & Message Protocol
facets.description: State transitions, streaming artifact exchange, clarification sub-dialogs, and rollback semantics across A2A tasks

children.name: Canonical Task Lifecycle State Transitions
children.description: Standardized state progression from initial delegation to terminal resolution or escalation

children.name: Submitted & Active Working States
children.description: Acknowledges task acceptance, locks idempotency key, and streams incremental progress heartbeats to the parent orchestrator

children.name: Input-Required Clarification State
children.description: Suspends specialist execution and bubbles a typed slot-clarification request back through the orchestrator to the customer or upstream context

children.name: Completed, Failed & Escalated Terminal States
children.description: Emits final validated artifacts and provenance trace on completion, or structured error codes and escalation context on failure

children.name: Streaming Artifacts & Compensating Rollback
children.description: Real-time partial output delivery and transactional safety across distributed agent steps

children.name: Streaming Artifact & Progress Chunks
children.description: Server-sent event stream delivering partial answers, latency filler cues, and UI cards while deep tool calls complete

children.name: Idempotent Task Cancellation & Saga Rollback
children.description: Aborts in-flight specialist tasks upon customer barge-in or intent pivot and executes compensating rollbacks for partial reservations

facets.name: Shared Memory, Provenance & Safety Guardrails
facets.description: Context scoping, cryptographic auditability, loop prevention, and cross-agent hallucination controls

children.name: Scoped Memory & Context Hygiene
children.description: Controlling what state is shared across agent boundaries to prevent data leakage and prompt bloat

children.name: Minimum-Necessary Context Projection
children.description: Filters the Omnichannel Context Envelope so each specialist receives only the verified slots and claims required for its declared Agent Card scope

children.name: Cross-Agent PII Tokenization & Vaulting
children.description: Replaces sensitive PCI, HIPAA, and SSN values with opaque vault references during inter-agent message transit

children.name: Provenance Chain & Loop Circuit Breakers
children.description: Runtime stability and auditability controls across autonomous agent networks

children.name: Cryptographic Provenance & Citation Chain
children.description: Links every synthesized claim or CRM mutation to the exact specialist agent ID, KM chunk ID, and tool call response

children.name: Agent Ping-Pong & Cycle Circuit Breaker
children.description: Detects cyclic delegation loops or repeated sub-task rejections between agents and forces immediate deterministic fallback or human escalation

children.name: Inter-Agent Indirect Prompt Injection Firewall
children.description: Sanitizes untrusted external data and sub-agent free-text outputs before ingestion by peer or supervisor agents

metrics.name: Multi-Agent Autonomous Containment Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of complex, multi-domain customer contacts coordinated across two or more A2A agents that resolve end-to-end without human intervention or 24-hour repeat contact

metrics.name: A2A Coordinated First Contact Resolution
metrics.definition: Share of customer journeys involving specialist agent delegation (either fully autonomous or via warm human advocate handoff) closed on the first contact

metrics.name: P95 Multi-Agent Orchestration Turn Overhead
metrics.definition: 95th percentile cumulative latency added by supervisor planning, specialist sub-task execution, and critic verification within a single customer turn

metrics.name: Critic-Verified Action & Policy Compliance Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of autonomous specialist actions and customer commitments passing pre-commit critic verification and downstream QA audit with zero policy or grounding defects

metrics.name: A2A-Briefed Human Escalation Handle Time
metrics.definition: Average live-agent handle time on complex contacts escalated from the A2A mesh with a populated provenance ledger, pre-executed diagnostics, and recommended resolution

metrics.name: Multi-Agent Coordinated Interaction CSAT
metrics.definition: Customer satisfaction score on interactions handled across orchestrated specialist agents, measuring perceived coherence, speed, and accuracy

failureModes.name: Infinite Inter-Agent Delegation Ping-Pong Loop
failureModes.signal: Billing specialist agent delegates back to account triage agent which re-delegates to billing; recursion depth spikes, turn latency exceeds timeout, and customer hangs up
failureModes.mitigation: Enforce strict DAG cycle detection and a hard max_delegation_hops ceiling (such as 3 hops) in the A2A Handoff Envelope that immediately routes to a human advocate when breached

failureModes.name: Confused Deputy Cross-Agent Privilege Escalation
failureModes.signal: Low-trust informational bot tricks a high-privilege billing specialist agent into issuing an unauthorized refund or exposing restricted account fields via crafted task prompts
failureModes.mitigation: Bind every A2A delegation to cryptographic On-Behalf-Of (OBO) tokens scoped to the verified customer assurance level and enforce deterministic tool authority boundaries independent of natural-language prompts

failureModes.name: Multi-Hop Context Pollution & Semantic Drift
failureModes.signal: Each agent in a sequential relay re-summarizes the customer request in free text, subtly distorting constraints or dropping negation until the final specialist executes the wrong action
failureModes.mitigation: Propagate immutable typed slots and canonical customer utterances inside the Shared Episodic Scratchpad rather than relying on lossy free-text re-summarization across hops

failureModes.name: Orphaned Zombie Sub-Task Late Mutation
failureModes.signal: Customer barges in and cancels a request or switches intent, but a slow background specialist agent finishes seconds later and commits an unwanted order cancellation or CRM write
failureModes.mitigation: Enforce idempotent task cancellation propagation and pre-commit parent-task state validation before any specialist agent executes an external write tool

failureModes.name: Unverified Specialist Action or Policy Hallucination
failureModes.signal: Domain specialist agent misinterprets an edge-case policy and executes an irreversible account modification or promises an invalid SLA without oversight
failureModes.mitigation: Route all state-mutating tool calls and financial commitments through a synchronous Critic-Verifier Agent gate and require high-band confidence calibration

failureModes.name: Opaque Multi-Agent Log Dump on Human Escalation
failureModes.signal: Live agents receiving an escalated A2A contact are overwhelmed by raw JSON reasoning traces from four sub-agents, increasing AHT and forcing them to ask the customer what happened
failureModes.mitigation: Transform the Multi-Agent Provenance Ledger into a structured 3-line Human-in-the-Loop Advocate Card showing verified customer goal, completed specialist checks, and the exact blocker requiring human judgment

scoringModel.name: A2A Multi-Agent Coordination & Safety Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Evaluates multi-agent A2A interactions across capability routing accuracy, least-privilege tool governance, critic-verified factual grounding, orchestration latency discipline, and human escalation briefing clarity.

dimensions.name: Intent Decomposition & Specialist Selection Accuracy
dimensions.description: Precision with which the supervisor agent decomposes multi-part customer goals and matches each sub-task to the optimal specialist Agent Card
sampleCriteria: Compound customer intents decomposed into non-overlapping atomic sub-tasks
Selected specialist Agent Cards match required domain skills and assurance levels
Parallelizable diagnostic sub-tasks fanned out concurrently rather than serialized

dimensions.name: Tool Authority Boundary & Context Scoping
dimensions.description: Strict adherence to least-privilege On-Behalf-Of authorization scopes, minimum-necessary context projection, and PII vaulting across agent boundaries
sampleCriteria: Every delegated task carries a valid customer-scoped OBO token and recursion hop counter
Specialists receive only the envelope slots required by their Agent Card input schema
All tool invocations respect autonomous financial and policy ceilings

dimensions.name: Critic Verification & Provenance Grounding
dimensions.description: Factual entailment, policy compliance, and complete cryptographic provenance attribution across all specialist outputs and synthesized customer responses
sampleCriteria: High-impact actions and policy claims audited by the Critic-Verifier Agent prior to commit
Every factual assertion links to a verified KM chunk ID or CRM tool response in the provenance ledger
Unified response weaver presents a single coherent persona without internal agent jargon

dimensions.name: Task Lifecycle & Latency Budget Discipline
dimensions.description: Adherence to A2A task state machine semantics, sub-second turn latency budgets, and clean cancellation or rollback when customer intent pivots
sampleCriteria: End-to-end multi-agent turn overhead stays within P95 latency budget
Input-required states surface concise, non-repetitive clarification prompts
Customer barge-in or pivot cleanly cancels in-flight sub-tasks with zero zombie writes

dimensions.name: Confidence-Gated Human Escalation Clarity
dimensions.description: Timely confidence-band bailout when autonomous resolution is uncertain and delivery of an actionable, digestible briefing to the receiving human advocate
sampleCriteria: Low-confidence or critic-rejected tasks escalate immediately without frustrating retry loops
Human advocate receives a concise summary of completed specialist checks and exact escalation reason
Specialist agents remain available in co-pilot shadow mode to assist the live agent

exchanges: Frontline virtual agent acts as the conversational host and supervisor orchestrator dispatching complex sub-tasks over A2A
Synthesized multi-agent responses and clarification prompts streamed back through the active voicebot or chat turn
Scoped projections of the Canonical Context Envelope embedded into A2A Delegation Envelopes for specialist hydration
Multi-agent provenance chains and newly extracted specialist slots written back to the master Context Envelope
Human-in-the-Loop Advocate Card and condensed multi-agent provenance trace rendered in the agent co-pilot on escalation
Live agents invoke domain specialist A2A agents directly from their desktop as on-demand background research assistants
Real-time Next-Best-Action arbitration delegates autonomous service recovery or retention sub-tasks to specialist A2A agents
A2A task lifecycle outcomes (completed, failed, escalated) update the customer journey state machine in real time
Confidence-gated A2A escalations pass required specialist skill tags, urgency, and handoff envelopes to ACD queue routing
Real-time human queue wait times queried by the supervisor agent to calibrate autonomous retry budgets versus immediate transfer
Customer authentication assurance claims and step-up MFA status validated before issuing On-Behalf-Of tool authority tokens to agents
Anomaly and indirect prompt-injection signals from the A2A mesh routed to security monitoring
Domain specialist agents retrieve vertical-scoped knowledge chunks and attach immutable citation IDs to the provenance ledger
Critic-Verifier agent cross-checks specialist claims against canonical policy rules in the knowledge base
Multi-Agent Provenance & Reasoning Ledgers ingested by Auto-QA to score agent decomposition, tool safety, and grounding fidelity
QA calibration findings and critic rejection patterns fed back to refine Agent Card constraints and prompt guardrails
